en.p: A pouch contains 4 white balls with the numbers 1, 2, 3, 4 written on them, one each, and 4 black balls with the numbers 4, 5, 6, 7 written on them, one each. Using this pouch, a trial that awards a score according to the following rule is performed.

box: Draw 2 balls at random from the pouch at the same time.
If the drawn balls are of different colors, the score is 12;
if the drawn balls are of the same color, the score is the product of the numbers written on the two balls.

en.p: When the probability that the score obtained from performing this trial once is an even number at most 24 is $\dfrac{q}{p}$, find the value of $p+q$. (Here $p$ and $q$ are relatively prime natural numbers.) [4 points]
